_comment: Destination-level facts for /plumber/texas, from registered TSBPE sources only. Every quote is verbatim from the raw source text (fetched 2026-10-22); scripts/knowledge-base/tests.ts checks each sourceUrl is a registered authoritative source.
heading: How Texas licenses plumbers

items.label: Licence classes
items.text: TSBPE's rules (22 TAC Chapter 363, Examination and Registration) set out a Master Plumber License (§363.4), a Journeyman Plumber License (§363.5), a Tradesman Plumber-Limited License (§363.6) and a Plumbing Inspector License (§363.8), along with a Plumber's Apprentice Registration (§363.7) and other registrations and endorsements.

items.label: Louisiana
items.text: TSBPE announced a reciprocal licence agreement with Louisiana (January 11, 2022):
items.quote: Louisiana Journeymen with Gasfitter Licensees in Good Standing are Now Eligible to Obtain the Equivalent License in Texas, No Exam Required

items.label: Responsible Master Plumber
items.text: The rules define a Responsible Master Plumber (RMP) as a licensed Master Plumber who, among other things:
items.quote: allows the person's Master Plumber License to be used by only one plumbing company for the purpose of offering and performing plumbing work

items.label: Journeyman Plumber
items.quote: To be eligible for a Journeyman Plumber License an applicant must have completed forty-eight (48) hours of classroom training provided by an approved instructor in an approved training program

items.label: Journeyman Plumber
items.text: Experience, which can be gained outside Texas:
items.quote: have at least 8,000 hours of experience working at the trade under the supervision of a RMP or a Master Plumber licensed in another state

items.label: Journeyman Plumber
items.text: The applicant must also hold an apprentice registration, a Tradesman Plumber-Limited License, or
items.quote: a current Journeyman Plumber License issued in another state

items.label: Master Plumber
items.text: A Journeyman licence from another state counts toward a Master Plumber License:
items.quote: an applicant must have held a Journeyman Plumber License issued in Texas or another state: (1) for at least two years; or (2) for at least one year if the applicant has successfully completed a training program approved by the United States Department of Labor, Office of Apprenticeship or another nationally-recognized apprentice training program accepted by the Board

items.label: Plumbing Inspector
items.text: An out-of-state Journeyman or Master licence qualifies an applicant for a Plumbing Inspector License, but not without the exam:
items.quote: An applicant who holds a Journeyman or Master Plumber License issued in another state must take and pass the examination developed by the Board.

items.label: Out-of-State Examination
items.text: TSBPE's Out-of-State Examination Application (revised March 2026) is for a Journeyman or Master licence. The licence must have been held for two years; the non-refundable processing fee is $40 for Journeyman and $25 for Master, with a separate computer-based exam fee paid to Pearson VUE that the form does not state. Fingerprints are required, submitted once through IdentoGO. The Journeyman exam also includes a practical portion.

items.label: Out-of-State Examination
items.text: Waiting periods after a failed exam:
items.quote: (1) First failure: a 30-day waiting period, (2) Second failure, a 60-day waiting period, (3) Third and subsequent failures: a 90-day waiting period.

openQuestions.text: The form words its licence requirement two ways. Its minimum requirements say "Proof applicant is currently licensed as a Journeyman or Master Plumber in another state"; its checklist asks for a "Legible copy of the applicant’s current, state-issued Residential, Journeyman or Master plumbing license". Whether a Residential plumbing licence alone qualifies is not settled by the form.
